definition.title: Premium Role Fit by Future Caregiver

fields.title: How would you describe your personality?
How do you generally cope with stress or challenging situations?

choices.label: I prefer to avoid or escape from it

fields.title: How would you describe your relationship with the future care recipient?
In your relationship with the future care recipient, how do you typically handle disagreements or conflicts?

choices.label: One of us usually concedes to the other

fields.title: How would you describe the level of trust in your relationship?
How often do you currently communicate (in person, phone calls, email, etc.)?
How would you describe your level of emotional closeness with each other?
What is your preferred role in a potential caregiving scenario?

choices.label: Direct caregiver, assisting with daily activities
Financial manager, handling costs and budgets
Emotional support provider, offering comfort and companionship
Medical decision-maker, assuming healthcare proxy duties

fields.title: Prioritize these factors considering your potential caregiving involvement:
Under what circumstances would you be willing to provide assistance post-treatment?
Evaluate your willingness and capability to provide care if required:
Assess your financial stability concerning possible caregiving-related expenses or working hour reductions:
Have you had any previous experience or knowledge in caregiving?
Identify who could potentially provide you with support if you became a caregiver:
How would you describe your existing relationship with the potential care recipient?
Estimate the number of hours per week you foresee devoting to caregiving duties:
How do you perceive the potential shift in your relationship with the care recipient due to the caregiving role?
Do you anticipate any emotional strain resulting from caregiving responsibilities?
How concerned are you about the financial implications of assuming a caregiving role?
Do you foresee caregiving duties interfering with your other roles or responsibilities (work, parenting, etc.)?
Rate your current physical stress levels:
Evaluate your current emotional stress levels:
Do you have other dependent family members (children, spouse, parents, etc.) who rely on you for care or support? If yes, how might this impact your ability to provide care for another individual?
Are you currently managing any chronic health issues of your own that may impact your ability to provide care?
What is your current understanding of the potential care recipient's medical condition and care needs?
Are you willing to undergo training or education to improve your caregiving skills?
What kind of support services would you consider utilizing to help with caregiving responsibilities?

choices.label: I don't foresee needing any support services

fields.title: How do you feel about potential end-of-life care decisions and discussions?
Do you feel you have a voice in the decision-making process around the potential care recipient's treatment and care plans?
How would you cope with potential setbacks, such as the care recipient's health deteriorating or not improving as expected?
Are you prepared for the potential duration of the caregiving role? (This can sometimes span several years.)
Are you prepared to handle the potential financial responsibilities associated with caregiving?
Are you prepared for the possibility that the person you are caring for may not appreciate or acknowledge your efforts, especially in cases where they have cognitive decline?
How do you deal with emotional stress, frustration, or feelings of overwhelm?

choices.label: I often struggle with managing these feelings
I don't have any coping strategies

choices.label: Yes, and it won't significantly impact these relationships
Yes, and there may be some impact
This is a significant concern for me
